runSummary.note: Real 16 Sep 12:14 sweep. Twelve independent source families were actually queried: Profesia, direct company/public career pages, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, WordPress Jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities, public Facebook indexing and additional public company-career discovery. LinkedIn freshly reverified Kaufland Service & Support Bratislava as active; it is already known from the prior run and therefore not duplicated. A pharco Ecommerce Manager role in Bratislava was found but is a full-time on-site manager role and was not promoted without stronger evidence on requirements/pay. Upwork produced operational WooCommerce candidates, but the strongest listing/upload role is already three weeks old with 20-50 proposals, 1 hire and 4 interviews; newer roles skew toward expert PHP/development. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable posts.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Manager-title evidence gate
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: For manager/lead titles, require explicit evidence on hands-on scope, seniority, salary and language before promotion; prevents attractive e-commerce keywords from overpowering hidden seniority mismatch.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Reverification dedupe ledger
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Record when an already-known candidate resurfaces freshly on another source and update evidence freshness without creating a new feed item; preserves stable IDs while improving confidence and source resilience.

policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data was attempted.
